input.subject: [E22] Old Stock Razer BlackShark
input.body: Hey ByteMart, I ordered the Razer BlackShark V2 Pro on August 15 and received it today, but I noticed that the product was manufactured in December 2024. I paid the regular retail price, so I believe an older stock item should have been offered with an additional discount. Please let me know if you can provide a partial refund or suitable compensation for this.

args.query: What is ByteMart's policy on partial refunds or compensation for older stock items?
What is ByteMart's refund policy for products that do not meet customer expectations?

resolver.draft:
Hi Anjali,

Thank you for reaching out to ByteMart support.

Re: [PENDING APPROVAL] Request for Partial Refund for Razer BlackShark V2 Pro

We understand your concern regarding the older stock item you received. Our team is reviewing your request for a partial refund or suitable compensation. Please allow us some time to assess the situation, and we will get back to you shortly.

Best regards,
ByteMart Customer Support
resolver.reasoning: The request for a partial refund due to receiving an older stock item maps to a HILT trigger. The order is delivered, and the request requires operator review as per the refund policy.
